name: @lit-core/css-fuse
description: AOT constructable stylesheet deduplication engine for web components

scripts.build: cargo build --release && cp target/release/libcss_fuse.dylib css-fuse.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true; cp target/release/css-fuse-bin bin/css-fuse-bin 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build && cp target/debug/libcss_fuse.dylib css-fuse.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true; cp target/debug/css-fuse-bin bin/css-fuse-bin 2>/dev/null || true
